# Managing workloads with the {{ js_operator }} {#js-managing}

Use the {{ js_operator }} on OpenShift Container Platform to manage and run large-scale, coordinated workloads like high-performance computing (HPC) and AI training. Features like multi-template job support and stable networking can help you recover quickly and use resources efficiently.
